auth.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Game server management, built for Windows.

setup.title: Create the administrator
setup.subtitle: This panel has no users yet. The first account gets full access.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the panel log when it started. It proves you have access to the server.

forbidden.title: Not available
forbidden.description: Your roles do not include access to this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist, or it is not available yet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.nothing: Nothing to show yet: your roles don't include servers, nodes or the audit log.

alerts.title: Needs attention
alerts.crashLoop: {{name}} keeps crashing and was not restarted again

users.title: Users
users.description: People who can sign in to this panel, their global roles and their access to single nodes and servers.
users.selfNotice: This is your own account: your roles, status and password are managed by another administrator.
users.disableLabel: Disabled (cannot sign in; open sessions end within a minute)
users.passwordReset: Password changed. The user's sessions have ended.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete the user {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
users.resetTwoFactorConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for {{name}}? Their sessions end; if a role requires it, they set it up again at their next sign-in.
users.revokeApiKeysConfirm: Revoke every API key of {{name}}? Whatever uses them stops working now.

access.title: Access to nodes and servers
access.hint: A node or server role applies there only: the user sees and manages that node (with its servers) or that server, and nothing else.
access.empty: No roles on single nodes or servers.
access.noRoles: There are no roles of this scope yet: create one in Roles.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Sets of permissions you assign to users. Administrator is built in and always has every permission.
roles.name: Name
roles.scopeHint: Where the role is assigned: the whole panel, one node or one server. It cannot change later.
roles.scopeFixed: The scope cannot change once the role exists.
roles.requireTwoFactorFor: Require two-factor authentication from users of {{name}}

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, and when. Entries cannot be edited.

auth.recovery_code_used: Signed in with a recovery code

user.two_factor_reset: Turned off a user's two-factor authentication

node.credential_rotation_requested: Asked a node to rotate its key

server.template_changed: Moved a server to another version of its template
server.backup_limit_changed: Changed how many backups to keep
server.limits_changed: Changed the CPU and memory limits

security.insecureDescription: Passwords and sessions travel in clear text. Use HTTPS outside a trusted network.

addon.not_found: The server's game has no such mod.
addon.unsupported: The node's agent cannot install mods: update the agent.

api_key.name_invalid: Give the key a name of one line, up to 64 characters.
api_key.too_many: You have too many API keys: revoke one first.
api_key.not_found: That key does not exist any more.

auth.required: Your session ended. Sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
auth.wrong_current_password: The current password is not correct.
auth.two_factor_required: Set up two-factor authentication to continue.
auth.two_factor_required_by_role: One of your roles requires two-factor authentication.

setup.invalid_token: The setup token is not valid. Copy it again from the panel log.
setup.completed: The panel has already been set up.

antiforgery.invalid: The page is out of date. Reload it and try again.

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

role.name_invalid: The role name must have between 1 and 64 characters.
role.system_immutable: Built-in roles cannot be changed or deleted.
role.permission_unknown: One of the permissions does not exist.
role.permission_not_grantable: One of the permissions cannot be part of a role with this scope.
role.name_taken: Another role already has this name.
role.in_use: The role is assigned to users. Remove it from them first.

access.scope_mismatch: That role cannot be assigned here.
access.self_change: You cannot change your own access.
access.escalation: You can only grant or change permissions you hold yourself.
access.last_administrator: At least one administrator must remain.

transport.https_required: This panel only accepts HTTPS. Open it with https://.

node.name_invalid: The node name must have between 1 and 64 characters.
node.public_host_invalid: The public address must be a host name or an IP address.
node.name_taken: Another node already has this name.
node.not_connected: The node's agent is not connected.
node.allocation_address_invalid: Use an IPv4 address (0.0.0.0 for every interface).
node.allocation_port_invalid: Ports go from 1 to 65535: a port, a range (27015-27030) or a list.
node.allocation_range_too_large: Add at most 1000 ports at a time.
node.allocation_taken: The node already has an allocation on that port (on that address or on every interface).

panel_key.rotation_in_progress: The previous key is still being retired. Retire it before rotating again.
panel_key.not_retiring: Only a key that is being retired can be retired.
panel_key.not_found: The panel key does not exist.

server.name_invalid: The server name must have between 1 and 64 characters.
server.template_unsupported: That node's agent cannot run this game.
server.busy: Another operation is running on this server. Wait for it to finish.
server.not_installed: The server is not installed yet.
server.command_rejected: The node's agent rejected the command.
server.extra_arguments_invalid: Extra arguments are single lines of up to 512 characters (32 at most).
server.extra_arguments_not_allowed: This game does not allow extra arguments.
server.no_free_allocation: The node has no free allocation for one of the game's ports. Add allocations to the node.
server.allocation_unavailable: That allocation is not free on the server's node.

template.version_exists: That game version is already registered. Templates never change: give it a new version.

operation.not_cancellable: Only running installs, updates and backups can be cancelled.
operation.forbidden: You may not cancel this kind of operation on this server.

files.not_found: That file or folder does not exist.
files.exists: A file or folder with that name already exists.
files.reparse_point: That is a link (a junction or symbolic link): Pulsar does not follow links.
files.outside_server: That path leads outside the server's folder.
files.access_denied: The server's account cannot access that file.
files.in_use: The file is in use (the game may hold it open). Try again with the server stopped.
files.changed: The file changed on the server meanwhile.
files.transfer_failed: The transfer between the panel and the node did not complete. Try again.
files.failed: The node could not do it: {{detail}}
files.unsupported: The node's agent has no file manager. Update the agent.
files.length_required: The upload did not say its size.
files.invalid_version: The file version is not valid. Reload the file.

backups.name_invalid: A backup name is one line of up to 128 characters.
backups.limit_invalid: Keep between 1 and 1000 backups, or leave it empty to keep them all.
backups.locked: The backup is locked: unlock it before deleting it.
backups.unsupported: The node's agent cannot make backups. Update the agent.
backups.in_use: The backup is being downloaded or restored. Try again when that ends.

http.network: Could not reach the panel. Check your connection.

schedules.not_found: That scheduled task does not exist.
schedules.name_invalid: A task name is one line of up to 128 characters.
schedules.cron_invalid: That is not a cron expression of five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week.
schedules.time_zone_invalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
schedules.only_if_running_unsupported: Only restarts and backups can wait for the server to run.
schedules.command_required: Write the console command to send (one line, up to 512 characters).
schedules.command_sensitive: A scheduled command cannot set a password or another secret: it would be kept and shown in clear.
schedules.too_many: A server can have up to 50 scheduled tasks.
schedules.forbidden: You may schedule only what you may do yourself on this server.
schedules.missed: The panel was not running at that time.
schedules.interrupted: The panel stopped before the run ended.
schedules.error: The panel could not run the task; its log has the details.

notifications.not_found: That notification channel does not exist.
notifications.name_invalid: A channel name is one line of up to 64 characters.
notifications.servers_invalid: Choose up to 200 servers, or every server.
notifications.server_unknown: One of the chosen servers no longer exists.
notifications.webhook_invalid: That is not a Discord webhook address (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
notifications.too_many: The panel has as many channels as it can (50).
notifications.panel_url_invalid: The panel address is an http or https address, like https://panel.example.com:8443.
notifications.thresholds_invalid: Low disk is 1 to 50 % free; a node is offline after 1 to 1440 minutes.
notifications.smtp_host_invalid: That is not a host name or address.
notifications.smtp_port_invalid: The port is a number from 1 to 65535.
notifications.smtp_user_invalid: That user name is not valid.
notifications.from_invalid: The sender is one valid email address and an optional short name.
notifications.email_not_configured: Email is off: set the SMTP server in the settings first.

backup_storage.not_found: That backup storage does not exist.
backup_storage.name_invalid: A storage name is one line of up to 64 characters.
backup_storage.endpoint_invalid: The endpoint is the service's https address (like https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com), or empty for AWS S3.
backup_storage.region_invalid: The region is a name like us-east-1 or auto.
backup_storage.bucket_invalid: A bucket name is 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens.
backup_storage.prefix_invalid: The folder is made of letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, separated by slashes.
backup_storage.access_key_invalid: That access key id is not valid.
backup_storage.in_use: Servers or backups use this storage: choose another storage for those servers, or delete their backups, first.
backup_storage.too_many: The panel has as many storages as it can (20).

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, password, two-factor authentication and API keys.
account.userNameFixed: The user name cannot be changed.
account.emailHint: Optional. Not shown to other users.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Windows machines that run game servers. Each one runs the Pulsar agent, which connects to this panel.
nodes.emptyManage: There are no nodes yet. Add one, then run the command it gives you on the Windows machine.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.nameHint: How you will recognize it, e.g. "Buenos Aires 1".
nodes.publicHostHint: Optional. The host name or IP players use to reach servers on this node.
nodes.noInventory: The agent has not connected yet, so there is nothing to show.
nodes.offlineSince: The agent is not connected. Last seen {{date}}.
nodes.administrationHint: Disabling or deleting a node, or revoking its credential, disconnects its agent immediately.
nodes.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? Its agent is disconnected until you enable it again.
nodes.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its agent is disconnected and must be enrolled again to come back.

enroll.title: Enroll {{name}}
enroll.steps: On the Windows machine, extract the Pulsar release ZIP, open PowerShell as administrator in its folder and run:
enroll.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Select the command and copy it by hand.
enroll.once: The command works once, until {{expires}}. It is not shown again: create a new one if you lose it.
enroll.fingerprint: The agent checks that the panel holds the key {{fingerprint}}, so a copy of this command is useless against any other server.
enroll.trust: If the panel's certificate is self-signed, copy panel.cer from the panel's machine (C:\ProgramData\Pulsar\Panel\tls) next to the script and add -TrustCertificate .\panel.cer.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: The public key of the node. Its private half never leaves the machine.
credentials.empty: The node has not been enrolled yet.
credentials.revokeDescription: The agent is disconnected immediately and cannot connect again until the node is re-enrolled.

nodes.rotateStarted: The agent is replacing its key. The new credential appears below once it connects with it (old keys are also replaced automatically every 90 days).

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Game servers on your nodes: their state and what you can do with them.
servers.empty: There are no servers you can see yet.
servers.emptyCreate: No servers yet. Create one on a connected node.
servers.nodeHint: Only connected nodes are listed: the server is set up on its machine right away.
servers.name: Name

reasons.readinessTimedOut: Running, but it never reported it was ready.
reasons.crashLoop: Crashed too many times in a row; start it again once it is fixed.
reasons.stopTimedOut: Did not stop in time and was killed.
reasons.startFailed: Could not start. Check the operations and the agent log.
reasons.agentStopping: Stopped because its node's agent stopped.
reasons.agentStarted: Started again by its node's agent.
reasons.memoryLimit: Stopped at its memory limit (exit code {{code}}). Raise the limit or lower what it uses.

servers.killConfirm: Kill {{name}} now? Its processes end without saving.
servers.commandRefused: The node did not accept the command ({{status}} {{code}}).
servers.administrationHint: Reinstalling prepares the server's folder and account again and runs its install. Deleting removes its files, its backups and its Windows account from the node.
servers.reinstallConfirm: Reinstall {{name}}? Its game files are installed again.
servers.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its files, its backups and its Windows account are removed from the node. This cannot be undone.
servers.templateUpgrade: This server runs version {{current}} of its game template; version {{next}} is available.
servers.templateUpgradeConfirm: Move {{name}} to version {{version}} of its template? It must be stopped; it is installed again with it and keeps its files and settings.
servers.validateFiles: Also verify every installed file (slow; repairs a damaged install)

wizard.requirements: This game needs about {{disk}} GB of disk and {{memory}} GB of memory on the node.
wizard.noPorts: This game does not listen on any port.
wizard.noAllocations: The node has no free allocations for the game's ports.
wizard.automatic: Automatic (a free one, the usual port first)

variables.secretSet: A value is set; type a new one to replace it.
variables.protected: Only users who can edit server settings can change it.
variables.badFormat: The format is not valid for this setting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Changes apply the next time the server starts.
settings.saved: Settings saved. They apply at the next start.
settings.extraArgumentsHint: One per line; each line is one argument, added after the game's own.
settings.autoStart: Start when the node's agent starts

limits.title: Resources
limits.hint: Caps on the server's share of its node's CPU and on the memory its processes commit. They apply to a running server at once. A game that needs more memory than its limit stops (and says why).
limits.noneSet: No limits: the server may use the whole node.
limits.cpuValue: CPU: up to {{value, number}} % of the node

network.title: Ports
network.hint: Each port uses one of the node's allocations.
network.stopFirst: Stop the server to change its ports.
network.none: This game does not listen on any port.

console.title: Console
console.reconnecting: Live updates stopped; reconnecting… The output resumes where it stopped.
console.nodeOffline: The node is offline: no output until it reconnects.
console.commandPlaceholder: Type a command and press Enter

players.title: Players
players.name: Name
players.notListed: The game does not list its players.

panelKeys.title: Panel signing key
panelKeys.description: Agents only accept commands signed with a key they trust. Rotating it starts signing with a new key and sends it to every node; retire the old one once all of them have it.
panelKeys.notEveryNode: {{outdated}} node(s) still trust only the old key and {{unknown}} have not reported their keys. They receive the new key when they connect.
panelKeys.rotateConfirm: Create a new panel signing key? Connected nodes receive it now, the others when they connect. The current key keeps working until you retire it.
panelKeys.retireConfirm: Retire the old key? Nodes that do not have the new one yet ({{outdated}} outdated, {{unknown}} unknown) will stop accepting commands until they are enrolled again.

allocations.title: Allocations
allocations.description: Addresses and ports servers on this node can use (UDP and TCP). 0.0.0.0 means every interface of the node.
allocations.empty: No allocations yet: servers need one for each of their ports.

templates.title: Games
templates.description: The game templates servers are created from: the ones shipped with Pulsar and the ones administrators imported.
templates.importHint: A template decides what every node runs and downloads. Check what it does before importing it.
templates.alreadyImported: This version is already registered. Templates never change: give it a new version.
templates.previousVersion: It replaces version {{version}} for new servers.

files.title: Files
files.name: Name
files.truncated: Only the first {{count}} entries are shown.
files.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete the folder {{name}} and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
files.busy: An operation is changing this server's files: changes are blocked until it ends.

nameProblems.characters: Names cannot contain \ / : * ? " < > | or control characters.
nameProblems.dots: Names cannot be . or .., start with a space or end with a dot or a space.
nameProblems.reserved: Windows reserves that name (CON, NUL, COM1…).

uploads.label: Uploading {{name}}
uploads.exists: A file with that name already exists.

editor.label: Contents of {{name}}
editor.conflict: The file changed on the server since you opened it. Reload it (your changes are lost) or overwrite it with yours.
editor.tooLarge: This file is larger than 1 MB: download it instead.
editor.binary: This file is not text: download it instead.

addons.hint: Mods and mod frameworks this game's template knows. The node downloads their latest release from their authors' GitHub and installs it only when it matches the checksum GitHub publishes. They are made by third parties, under their own licences.
addons.stopToChange: Stop the server to install, update or remove mods.
addons.reinstallAfterUpdate: Game updates overwrite it: it is installed again after each update.
addons.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from {{server}}? The files it installed are deleted, even if you changed them; files you added yourself are kept.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: Backups are zip files kept on the server's node. They hold the files the game's template chooses (its configuration, its add-ons), not what can be downloaded again.
backups.name: Name
backups.nameHint: Optional. Without one, the backup is named after the time it was made.
backups.runningWarning: The server is running: files it writes during the backup may be saved half written. Stop it first for a consistent copy.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}} into {{server}}? The backup's files replace the server's current ones; files the backup does not have stay as they are.
backups.stopToRestore: Stop the server to restore a backup.
backups.deleteConfirm: Delete the backup {{name}}? Its file is removed from the node. This cannot be undone.

retention.title: Retention
retention.hint: After each new backup, the oldest ones beyond this number are deleted. Locked backups are always kept and do not count.
retention.invalid: A whole number from 1 to {{max}}, or empty to keep them all.
retention.confirm_one: Keep only the newest backup? Older unlocked ones are deleted now.
retention.confirm_other: Keep only the {{count}} newest backups? Older unlocked ones are deleted now.

remote.title: Remote copy
remote.hint: Each new backup is also copied to remote storage, so it survives the loss of this node. A backup the node no longer has is brought back from there to restore or download it.
remote.none: The panel has no backup storage yet: settings managers add one in Administration → Backup storage.

schedules.title: Scheduled tasks
schedules.hint: Tasks run at their time in the time zone you choose, following its daylight saving time. The panel runs them: while it is not running, nothing runs, and missed runs are recorded rather than done late.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.commandHint: Sent as if typed in the console; skipped while the server is not running.
schedules.updateHint: An update needs the server stopped: schedule a stop before it and a start after it.
schedules.onlyIfRunning: Only while the server is running
schedules.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. For example, 30 5 * * 1-5 is 05:30 on weekdays.
schedules.timeZoneHint: The task runs at that time there, following its daylight saving time.
schedules.deleteConfirm: Delete the task {{name}} and its history?
schedules.missed_one: Missed: the panel was not running.
schedules.missed_other: {{count}} runs missed: the panel was not running.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.hint: For scripts and tools: send a key as "Authorization: Bearer <key>". It acts as you, with your permissions or only the ones you choose, and never reaches your account, password or keys.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Whatever uses it stops working now.
apiKeys.createdIntro: Copy it now: it is shown only this once. Keep it like a password.
apiKeys.usage: Send it in every request as: Authorization: Bearer <key>

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app:
twoFactor.codesIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if you lose the app. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.requiredByRole: One of your roles requires it.
twoFactor.newCodesDescription: The codes you have now stop working.
twoFactor.turnOffDescription: Sign-in will ask only for your password.
twoFactor.requiredSubtitle: One of your roles requires it. Set it up to continue.
twoFactor.loginApp: Enter the code your authenticator app shows.
twoFactor.loginRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each one works once.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get told on Discord or by email when a server crashes, a backup fails or a node goes offline.
notifications.noChannels: No channels yet. Add one to start getting notified.
notifications.name: Name
notifications.serversHint: Server events only for the chosen servers. Node events go to every channel that wants them.
notifications.webhookHint: In Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL.
notifications.webhookKeep: Leave it empty to keep the current webhook ({{id}}).
notifications.recipientsHint: Up to 10, one per line or separated by commas.
notifications.emailNeedsSmtp: Email channels need the SMTP server in the settings below.
notifications.deleteConfirm: Delete the channel {{name}}? Its message history goes too.
notifications.panelUrlHint: How people reach the panel, for links in messages (e.g. https://panel.example.com:8443). Empty: no links.
notifications.emailOff: Email is off until an SMTP server is set.

securities.none: None (a relay on this network only)

notifications.smtpPasswordKeep: Leave it empty to keep the saved password.

storage.title: Backup storage
storage.description: S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO…) that servers copy their backups to.
storage.empty: No storage yet. Add one, then choose it in a server's Backups tab.
storage.name: Name
storage.endpointHint: The service's address. Empty for AWS S3. Backblaze B2: https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com.
storage.regionHint: auto for Cloudflare R2; the bucket's region for AWS and B2; us-east-1 for most others.
storage.secretKeep: Leave it empty to keep the saved key.
storage.pathStyle: Bucket in the path (most S3-compatible services need it; AWS does not)
storage.keysHint: Give these keys access to this bucket only. Nodes get them inside each backup command and keep nothing.
storage.deleteConfirm: Delete the storage {{name}}? Backups already copied stay in the bucket.
